mapper.insert: INSERT INTO route_vote ( user_id, property_id, destination_id, vote_type, del_yn ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{propertyId}, #{destinationId}, #{voteType}, 'N' ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE vote_type = VALUES(vote_type), del_yn = 'N', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN vote_type = 'SAFE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS safeCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN vote_type = 'UNSAFE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unsafeCount, COUNT(*) AS totalVotes, MAX(CASE WHEN user_id = #{userId} THEN vote_type END) AS myVote FROM route_vote WHERE property_id = #{propertyId} AND destination_id = #{destinationId} AND del_yn = 'N'
